  It is not a benchmark yet.
body.expected: A full test-split plan run through runner.yml's --split test gate (require_plan + byte-identical retraining) and a mixed, harder task suite before headline claims.
body.actual: runner/results/ holds only dev-split runs; the --split test path (run.py:226-229) has never fired in anger - the contract's central gate is untested in production, and all accuracy claims are dev-split on one or two hosts.

body.claim: When the decision model succeeds, model_fail is cleared wholesale - erasing checker-chunk failures from the run's record and leaving shadow_nemotron.keep = None (it was set to None precisely because a chunk failed), so the P31 live trial's shadow comparison silently loses data.
body.expected: The decider overriding the checker is fine, but infrastructure failures stay recorded (they cost budget and feed diagnose/digest measures).
body.actual: read.json shows no failure whenever the decider answers, even if 2 of 3 checker calls failed on a chunk - the budget was spent and the failure class disappears from the record.
